description: This script manages the restart and configuration of a Wi-Fi hotspot using hostapd, including stopping and starting services, checking hotspot enablement, and configuring interfaces.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process and re-enables WLAN interfaces.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts them on WLAN interfaces.
